plotTwists: {user} winds up the potato... and it turns out to be a decoy rubber potato. The real one is still in {user}'s pocket.
{target} catches the potato mid-air and immediately starts eating it, unbothered.
The potato somehow triggers a chain reaction of vegetable-based chaos across the whole server.
A chicken wanders between them and steals the potato mid-flight, entirely unbothered. 🐔
{user} throws the potato, but it curves dramatically and boomerangs back to hit {user} instead.
A tiny cartoon explosion effect appears at the exact moment of impact, for extra effect. 💥
The Whisper Merchant appears and tries to sell {target} a 'certified potato-proof shield.'
